dedupe_keys.name: transforming public transit with a rural on demand microtransit project supporting dataset

description: Transforming Public Transit with a Rural On-Demand Microtransit Project [supporting dataset] is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Ryan Brumfield, North Carolina Department of Transportation. On September 1, 2020, the City of Wilson, North Carolina, with support from the North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) through an Accelerating Innovative Mobility (AIM) FY20 award, replaced its existing fixed route transit system with an on-demand microtransit service called RIDE. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-PDDC. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
